steps.title: Draw the walls
steps.instruction: Draw a big square in the middle of your paper. That is the front of the house.

steps.title: Add the roof
steps.instruction: Now draw a big triangle on top for the roof. Start at the left corner, go up to the point, then down to the right corner.

steps.title: Put in the door
steps.instruction: Draw a tall rectangle at the bottom middle for the door. Leave the bottom open so it sits on the ground.

steps.title: Add two windows
steps.instruction: Draw one small square on the left of the door and one on the right. Those are the windows.

steps.title: Finish with a chimney
steps.instruction: Draw a little chimney standing up on the right side of the roof. Great job, your house is done!
